payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute parity of popcount(e) as 0/1; build graph of same/diff constraints from edges and elf queries; BFS to 2-color nodes; assign unknown edges 0/1 accordingly.
payload.rationale: The solution reduces the problem to graph 2-coloring by using the XOR trick: popcount(XOR of edge values) mod 2 equals XOR of popcount(e) mod 2. This XOR identity is the core bit_xor_trick that enables the graph formulation.
